In FY 2025-26 the Company earned net profit after tax of ` 609 Lakhs from its total operations as against net profit after tax of ` 981 Lakhs in FY 2024-25.

Growth & demand: Sustained ~6.5% GDP growth, a Union Budget that supports digital initiatives, and the fact that some of the states have increasingly started focusing on space sector - are creating structural tailwinds for reliable Satcom solutions.
Global GDP growth has stabilized at approximately 3.3% (as per IMF estimates); however, the macroeconomic narrative is increasingly dominated by geopolitical developments.
According to IMF, India remains the world's fastest-growing large economy at ~6.5% GDP growth, driven by domestic demand and policy continuity.

Risks & challenges: Risk Management Framework and Internal Financial Controls The Company operates under a comprehensive enterprise-wide Risk Management Framework aligned with Tata Group governance principles, under which risks are identified and assessed across all business segments.
The Risk Management Committee (RMC) of the Board focuses on proactive risk identification and mitigation, monitoring and reviewing the risk management plan half yearly.

At the management level, the Internal Risk Management Committee - comprising the CEO, CFO, Chief Risk Officer, and key business/operations leaders - is responsible for the systematic identification, assessment, quantification, and mitigation of current and emerging risks.
